skill.name: kleros-curate
skill.description: Guide Kleros Curate registry work across Light Curate, Stake Curate, and Scout. It helps fetch policy metadata, build item payloads, compute deposits, and prepare reviewed registry transactions.
skill.summary: Prepare and review Kleros Curate registry submissions, challenges, deployments, and verification workflows.
skill.author: internet-court

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code formatting, public Kleros and IPFS URLs, GraphQL examples, and registry metadata text. One real issue remains: SKILL.md links to ../feedback/SKILL.md, which directs an agent outside the skill package boundary.

remediation.suggestion: Remove the ../feedback/SKILL.md reference or replace it with an HTTPS issue tracker link that does not require reading outside the skill directory.

remediation.issue: Documentation contains many inline commands and URLs that trigger marketplace scanners.
remediation.suggestion: Keep examples explicit, but label public endpoints and read-only local grep examples as documentation-only guidance.

content.value_statement: Kleros Curate workflows require exact policy metadata, schemas, deposits, and chain-specific contract steps. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a structured process for safe registry preparation and review.
actual_capabilities: Chooses the correct Curate flavor from user context or contract hallmarks.
Explains Light Curate, Stake Curate, and Scout submission workflows.
Guides MetaEvidence retrieval and item schema validation before upload.
Computes required deposit inputs from live onchain reads instead of estimates.
Prepares challenge, removal, evidence, appeal, deployment, and verification steps.
Documents IPFS path rules for Curate artifacts and evidence files.
limitations: It does not execute transactions without separate wallet tooling and user approval.
It depends on live chain, subgraph, gateway, and policy data being reachable.
It cannot guarantee that jurors will accept a submitted item or challenge.
It should not be used for non-Kleros registries or unrelated IPFS uploads.

use_cases.title: Submit a Registry Item
use_cases.description: Prepare item metadata, validate schema fields, upload artifacts, and calculate the required transaction value.

use_cases.title: Challenge a Bad Entry
use_cases.description: Review policy rules, prepare evidence, compute challenge deposits, and outline the challenge transaction.

use_cases.title: Launch a Public Registry
use_cases.description: Prepare MetaEvidence, policy files, constructor parameters, deployment checks, and frontend verification steps.

prompt_templates.title: Identify the Curate Flavor
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner triage for a registry task.
prompt_templates.prompt: I have a Kleros Curate registry task. Help me identify whether it uses Light Curate, Stake Curate, or Scout.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an Item Submission
prompt_templates.scenario: Build a submission plan from registry metadata.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me submit an item to this Curate registry. Fetch the current MetaEvidence, validate the schema, and list each required value.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Challenge
prompt_templates.scenario: Evaluate whether an existing item violates policy.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Curate item against the current policy. Tell me whether a challenge is justified and what evidence is needed.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Registry Deployment
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced deployment workflow with policy and constructor review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a new Kleros Curate registry deployment. Check MetaEvidence requirements, deposits, arbitrator settings, IPFS artifacts, and verification steps.

output_examples.input: I want to add a token to the Scout token registry.
output: The skill identifies Scout on Gnosis and uses the Scout overlay plus Light Curate workflow.
It lists the token logo, website, address, symbol, decimals, policy, IPFS, and deposit checks.
It asks for approval before any upload or transaction step.

output_examples.input: Can I challenge this address tag submission?
output: The skill fetches the current policy and registry state before making a recommendation.
It separates policy evidence from unsupported claims and estimates the live challenge deposit.
It prepares an evidence checklist for the user to approve.

output_examples.input: Help me deploy a registry for verified project profiles.
output: The skill outlines policy, MetaEvidence, schema, logo, factory, arbitrator, deposit, and simulation requirements.
It flags missing production metadata before upload.
It explains that frontend visibility requires a separate list-of-lists submission.

best_practices: Fetch live onchain state before computing deposits, fees, appeal windows, or MetaEvidence references.
Copy MetaEvidence columns exactly and change only the item values required by the registry.
Ask for explicit user approval before upload, challenge, deployment, or transaction submission.
anti_patterns: Do not estimate deposits, schema fields, chain addresses, or challenge periods from memory.
Do not submit placeholder JSON, malformed MetaEvidence, or inaccessible policy documents.
Do not use generic IPFS uploads for Curate artifacts without explaining durability risks.

faq.question: What Kleros Curate workflows does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers item submission, challenges, removals, evidence, appeals, deployments, registry discovery, and frontend verification.

faq.question: Does it support Scout registries?
faq.answer: Yes. It treats Scout as a Light Curate overlay for the known Gnosis registry set.

faq.question: Can it calculate deposits automatically?
faq.answer: It can guide live deposit calculation. It should not use cached values or estimates.

faq.question: Does it upload files to IPFS?
faq.answer: It documents the recommended Kleros upload path, but uploads still require tool support and user approval.

faq.question: Can it decide whether a submission will win a dispute?
faq.answer: No. It can compare evidence with policy, but jurors decide disputed outcomes.

faq.question: Is this useful outside Kleros Curate?
faq.answer: No. It is specialized for Kleros Curate, Stake Curate, and Scout registry workflows.
